angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,292,611 km at 318.17 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 3.1430 +/- 0.0239 mas (same row, RUWE 0.95): 318.17 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.858 +/- 0.119 solar radii from Zhou et al. 2019, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HAT-P-70 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..141Z/abstract): 1,292,611 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.89 +/- 0.01 solar masses from Zhou et al. 2019, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HAT-P-70 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..141Z/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 8450 +/- 540 K from Zhou et al. 2019, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HAT-P-70 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..141Z/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Zhou et al. 2019, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HAT-P-70 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..141Z/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hat-p-70.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.176, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-70 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.059 dex, from Zhou et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..141Z/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-70 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 1.22272, from Zhou et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..141Z/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-70 (pscomppars): age 0.6 Gyr, from Zhou et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..141Z/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-70 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 99.85 km/s, from Zhou et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..141Z/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
